name: WF-432 — Pipeline Capacity, Lead Routing & Acquisition Scaling Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'default').trim(); const period=String(b.period??'current').trim(); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,period,asOfDate:b.asOfDate??new Date().toISOString(),receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Pipeline Scaling Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const leads=Array.isArray(ctx.leads)?ctx.leads:[]; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const active=leads.filter(l=>!['closed','cancelled','dnc','suppressed'].includes(String(l.status??'').toLowerCase())); const queues={hot:[],warm:[],standard:[],nurture:[]}; for(const l of active){const q=String(l.queue??(n(l.priorityScore)>=80?'hot':n(l.priorityScore)>=60?'warm':n(l.priorityScore)>=35?'standard':'nurture')).toLowerCase(); (queues[q]??queues.standard).push(l);} const capacity=ctx.capacity??{}; const caps={hot:n(capacity.hot??capacity.hotCapacity),warm:n(capacity.warm??capacity.warmCapacity),standard:n(capacity.standard??capacity.standardCapacity),nurture:n(capacity.nurture??capacity.nurtureCapacity)}; const queueStats=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(queues).map(([k,v])=>{const cap=caps[k];const load=v.length;const utilization=cap?load/cap:null;return[k,{activeLeads:load,capacity:cap,utilization,overCapacity:cap>0?load>cap:false,availableCapacity:cap>0?Math.max(0,cap-load):null}]})); const totalActive=active.length; const totalCapacity=Object.values(caps).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0); const overloaded=Object.values(queueStats).filter(x=>x.overCapacity).length; const routingNeed=overloaded? 'rebalance_and_increase_capacity':totalCapacity>0&&totalActive/totalCapacity>=0.85?'increase_capacity_proactively':'maintain_current_capacity'; const hotNeed=queueStats.hot.overCapacity||queueStats.hot.utilization>=0.85; const recommendedActions=[]; if(hotNeed)recommendedActions.push('prioritize_hot_lead_response_capacity'); if(overloaded)recommendedActions.push('rebalance_leads_from_overloaded_queues'); if(totalCapacity>0&&totalActive/totalCapacity>=0.85)recommendedActions.push('add_routing_or_follow_up_capacity'); if(!recommendedActions.length)recommendedActions.push('maintain_current_routing_capacity'); const scalingGate={minimumEvidence:ctx.minimumEvidence??'capacity utilization plus qualified-lead and SLA performance',approvalRequired:true}; const idempotencyKey='wf432:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.period+':'+input.asOfDate; return [{json:{...input,pipelineScalingAssessment:{status:active.length?'assessed':'blocked',routingNeed,metrics:{totalActiveLeads:totalActive,totalCapacity,overallUtilization:totalCapacity?totalActive/totalCapacity:null,overloadedQueueCount:overloaded},queueStats,recommendedActions,scalingGate,flags:active.length?[]:['no_active_leads'],nextAction:active.length?'apply_routing_rebalance_or_capacity_plan':'acquire_or_restore_active_lead_pipeline',confidenceScore:active.length&&totalCapacity?91:active.length?68:20},idempotencyKey}}];
